cannotLocateCorrespondingExecution: Could not locate the corresponding execution
copyFailed: Copy failed, please select the content manually
truncatedNote: Content was truncated; the above is the saved snippet.
modelReviewContextDesc: Below is a snapshot of the input actually sent to the review model for this call. The background is only for understanding the current action; the ruling is based on the review policy.
legacyInputNote: This record uses a legacy input format and keeps the content actually sent at the time.
backgroundFromUserMessage: Taken from the current user message.
backgroundWorkerIntentLegacyNote: This is the worker intent summary sent in the legacy format; the current worker review no longer sends this content.
noBackgroundMessage: No background message was attached to this review.
noHistorySent: No historical calls or execution results were sent for this review.
historicalCallsLegacyTitle: Historical calls provided to the model at the time (legacy)
noPairableHistory: No pairable historical tool execution record was provided for this call.
historyTruncatedNote: History is a limited window; some content has been truncated.
viewFullModelInputJson: View full model review input JSON
noAuditSnapshotNote: This record has no saved approval detail snapshot, so the context, model's initial judgment, and execution output at the time cannot be restored.
digestOnlyNote: This historical record only saved a fingerprint of the review input, not the original input, so the context sent to the model at the time cannot be restored. This doesn't mean there was no context during review; newly produced model rulings keep an input snapshot.
noModelInputSavedNote: No model review input was saved for this record — it may have been decided directly by a rule, an error occurred before the model call, or it originates from an older version.
viewAuditSnippetNotSent: View conversation audit snippet (not sent to the model)
savedContextNote: Conversation record snippet saved at {time}. The content actually used by the model is the "model review input".
contextTruncatedNote: Only the most recent context is saved; some content has been truncated.
ambiguousCorrelationNote: There are concurrent calls with the same parameters, so the tool call cannot be uniquely correlated; this record does not show a guessed execution result.
noUniqueCorrelationId: No uniquely correlatable tool call ID was recorded.
expandHintDesc: Expand a record to see the tool request and approval decision, along with the context and execution result at the time.
recordsLoadFailed: Failed to load records: {error}. Click refresh to retry.
pendingLoadFailed: Failed to load pending approvals: {error}. Click refresh to retry.
noFilteredRecords: No approval records match the current filter
adjustFilterHint: Adjust the approval status or decision source, or clear the filter to see all records.
recordsWillAppearHint: Once a rule or model makes an approval decision, records will appear here.
